title: Elodie and the Escarpment
author: Freya Eriksen
blurb: Zephyrine Ravensworth, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the dry season ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
